svg.title: The CH341A dongle V357 in I2C/SPI mode: its header and edge rows, the chip pins behind them, what atiic drives
svg.text: CH341A dongle (V357) in I2C/SPI mode: the headers
Top view, USB-A right. Each hole: its silkscreen (the edge rows' from the back), the chip pin behind it, its role in mode 1a86:5512, atiic's name.
the same chip pin as a header hole
VCC and the chip at 3.3 V (the board comes on 5 V): for 3.3 V parts
1a86:5512, atiic's mode; on UART it's a serial port (1a86:5523)
ST7735S, GC9107, GC9A01, ST7302: RES D0, DC D1, CS D2, SCK, MOSI
SSD1680, SSD1681 e-papers: the same, BUSY on D4 (read)
MPU-6500 (GY-9250) on SPI: SCK, MOSI, MISO, NCS on D4
BMX055 on SPI: CS0-CS2 the three chips, PS on D4
BMX055 on I2C: SCL, SDA, PS on D0 (held high)
• atiic drives D0-D5 high, low or released (pins()) and reads D0-D7 (readPins()); SPI is SCK D3, MOSI D5, MISO D7, chip selects any of D0-D5.
• The header's CS0-CS2, SCK, MOSI, MISO are D0-D3, D5, D7 again on the bottom edge (dashed); D4 and D6 are on the edge only.
• SPI shifts least significant bit first: atiic reverses each byte. About 110 KB/s; mode 0 only.
• The header's TXD and RXD are UART mode's; in I2C/SPI mode the same chip pins (5, 6) are ERR and PEMP, inputs.
• The top edge is the EPP/MEM parallel port's (DS, AS, WR, WAIT, RST, SLCT, INT, ERR, PEMP): atiic doesn't use it.

Holes from the vendor's photos (YouXin, front and back: the back flipped top to bottom); chip pins from WCH CH341DS1, the CH341A (SOP-28) column (§4.2-4.6); not traced on the board. atiic docs/ch341.md, docs/setup.md.
